paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Abba, an Amora.

Mentioned in Menachot 31b, asking, “Between one column and the next, what is the rule?” Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Yirmiyah bar Akha; the Rif, Hilkhot Sefer Torah, reads Rav Yehudah bar Ada. Yuchasin does not mention him at all.

notes.text: שבעי is “who asked,” not “seven.” Yuchasin’s failure to list him is Hyman’s assertion.
The consulted Menachot passage names Rav Yehudah bar Abba. The other names and the claim about Yuchasin are reports in Hyman’s entry.
